title.zh: 授权甲米地省议会将4400美元（美国货币）从依法专用于道路与桥梁改善的资金中转拨用于全省一般开支的法案
title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF CAVITE TO DIVERT THE SUM OF FOUR THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED DOLLARS, UNITED STATES CURRENCY, FROM THE FUNDS BY LAW DEVOTED TO THE IMPROVEMENT OF ROADS AND BRIDGES, FOR GENERAL PROVINCIAL EXPENSES.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF CAVITE TO DIVERT THE SUM OF FOUR THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED DOLLARS, UNITED STATES CURRENCY, FROM THE FUNDS BY LAW DEVOTED TO THE IMPROVEMENT OF ROADS AND BRIDGES, FOR GENERAL PROVINCIAL EXPENSES.
title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép Hội đồng Tỉnh Cavite chuyển khoản 4400 đô la Mỹ từ quỹ được pháp luật dành riêng cho cải thiện đường xá và cầu cống sang chi tiêu chung của tỉnh
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้คณะกรรมการจังหวัดกาบิตีเปลี่ยนแปลงการจัดสรรเงินจำนวนสี่พันสี่ร้อยดอลลาร์สหรัฐจากกองทุนที่กฎหมายกำหนดไว้เฉพาะเพื่อปรับปรุงถนนและสะพานไปเป็นค่าใช้จ่ายทั่วไปของจังหวัด
title.id: Undang-Undang yang mengizinkan Dewan Provinsi Cavite mengalihkan jumlah 4400 dolar Amerika Serikat dari dana yang oleh undang-undang dikhususkan bagi peningkatan jalan dan jembatan untuk pengeluaran umum provinsi
title.ms: Akta yang memberi kuasa kepada Majlis Wilayah Cavite memindahkan jumlah USD4400 dari dana yang diwajibkan oleh undang-undang untuk penambahbaikan jalan dan jambatan kepada perbelanjaan umum wilayah

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The provincial board of the Province of Cavite is hereby authorized to divert from funds required
by law to be devoted to the improvement of roads and bridges a sum not exceeding four thousand four
hundred dollars, United States currency, to be spent for general provincial purposes, anything in Act
Numbered Three hundred and eighty-one to the contrary notwithstanding.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, January 27, 1903.
